mappings.boundary: two or more qualification-path roles require conflict surfacing
all four qualification-path roles require external review
self-review alone never satisfies external review
a different reviewer who still holds a qualification-path role is not independent
a reviewer cannot become a qualification-path role-holder while their review is relied upon

research_translation: Agent identity/authorization is separated from the decision procedure that qualifies the agent.
Evidence production, verification, and adjudication are treated as distinct control roles for independence analysis.
Concentration is surfaced rather than converted into a scalar sovereignty score.
deliberate_limits: This is a finite state/model-layer theorem, not a general legal rule.
The theorem does not prove substantive quality or honesty of an independent reviewer.
The theorem does not prohibit organizational role overlap; it requires explicit conflict/review handling.
The theorem does not establish competition-law compliance or external recognition.
Reviewer role-disjointness is modeled as a qualification-process lock; it is not a universal organizational separation-of-duties rule.
